acceptance.rationale: Require at least a 10% complete-flow improvement with a launch-clustered confidence interval excluding parity. Reject median regressions above 5%, observed tail regressions above 15%, and memory growth above 10% unless explicitly reviewed. Baseline-only data establishes variability; it cannot pass a speed comparison. Tail claims need the stated sample counts.

configuration.exclusionPolicy: Retain every attempted launch and sample. Unexpected errors invalidate a comparison, not individual slow observations. Only an explicitly documented external interruption can invalidate an entire run. Never rerun selectively.
configuration.executionOrder: Rotate workloads by launch index; paired engine comparisons must alternate which engine starts each launch pair.
configuration.resourceCoverage: External watchdog samples the observed descendant process tree, including separately grouped browser processes. Short-lived processes between samples may be missed; report this limitation.
configuration.failureDeadlineRationale: Allow cold assertion preparation and require retained predicate diagnostics for every intentional failure. The original 25 ms baseline remains separate deadline-stress evidence; all preparation stays in complete-suite time.
